title: Engineering Manager- Ceph & Distributed Storage
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring an Engineering Manager for Ceph & Distributed Storage. The world creates more than 2.5 quintillion bytes of data every day! We want to help teams to store data in open source storage on commodity hardware — safely, cheaply and simply.

Our goal is to make Ceph easy to install, manage and use — from large enterprise data center installations to half‑rack edge sites. We believe that distributed storage shouldn't be hard — and to keep up with the increasing data storage demands, it needs to be easier than ever before. We have a range of tools to bring to bear on the problem, and we're excited to make distributed Ceph easy enough that everyone does it.

As an engineering manager at Canonical you must be technically strong, but your responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do important work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and community. Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop strong engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution. You will be responsible for sound software architecture and best practices in software quality, testing and documentation.

What you'll do

  • Be an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organisation
  • Work from home with global travel up to 20% for internal and external events

Who you are

  • You have a software engineering background, preferably with Python and C++ experience
  • You have experience operating scale out storage clusters on Linux in production environments, preferably with Ceph
  • You love embracing new technologies and pushing the boundaries of what is possible
  • You love developing and growing people and have a track record of doing it
  • You have an interest in building products that improve how people operate software and infrastructure everywhere
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • You have experience in leading, managing, coaching and mentoring software developers towards delivering timely, high quality software together
  • You have solid experience working in an agile development environment

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Brazil - RJ - Rio de Janeiro: UX Researcher OR Senior UX Designer
description:
Select how often (in days) to receive an alert:

Date: Feb 2, 2026

Location: Rio de Janeiro, RJ, BR,

We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

Design the future of decision-making in energy.

Landmark, Halliburton’s technology division, is modernizing a global enterprise platform used by geoscientists and engineers to make high-impact operational decisions.

We are expanding our UX team and hiring for two dedicated roles:

  • Senior UX Designer
  • UX Researcher

These are distinct positions with focused scope, though hybrid profiles with strengths in both areas are welcome.

This is not incremental UI work. It is large-scale UX modernization across complex, legacy and cloud-based applications. You will help elevate product clarity, usability, and trust in deeply technical workflows used around the world.

You’ll work closely with product, engineering, and customers to embed user-centered thinking into roadmap decisions and product execution.

What You’ll Do

If You Are a Senior UX Designer

You will lead the design of complex workflows and deliver end-to-end solutions that raise the craft quality of Landmark applications.

  • Own UX design for major workflows or product areas
  • Translate business and technical requirements into intuitive, scalable design solutions
  • Create user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and polished visual designs
  • Apply and extend the Landmark design system; contribute new patterns when needed
  • Partner closely with product managers and engineers to align requirements and deliverables
  • Validate designs with users and iterate based on feedback
  • Participate in and elevate design reviews across the organization

If You Are a UX Researcher

You will embed insight into product strategy and modernization efforts, ensuring decisions are grounded in real user needs.

  • Plan and conduct qualitative and quantitative research across complex enterprise workflows
  • Lead usability testing, interviews, contextual inquiry, and journey mapping
  • Identify unmet user needs and opportunity areas within legacy and cloud applications
  • Synthesize findings into actionable insights for product and engineering teams
  • Influence roadmap decisions through evidence-based recommendations
  • Establish scalable research practices within product teams
  • Partner with designers to validate concepts and measure experience improvements

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

Senior UX Designer

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent experience
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating enterprise or technical product design
  • Mastery of interaction and visual design
  • Proficiency with Figma and modern prototyping tools
  • Experience working in Agile environments
  • Familiarity with Angular or React-based systems preferred

UX Researcher

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Factors, HCI, Psychology, or related field (advanced degree preferred)
  • Experience conducting research in enterprise or technical domains
  • Ability to translate research into product and business impact
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional product teams

For Both Roles

  • Experience navigating complex technical environments
  • Strong communication and stakeholder influence skills
  • Comfort working in legacy systems undergoing modernization
  • A desire to shape and elevate UX within a global enterprise organization

You will have the freedom to drive change and influence the direction of our products and processes.

In our technical stack, we employ Ruby on Rails for the backend and a combination of Apollo, TypeScript, and React for the frontend.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Experience with other non-frontend programming languages and technical stacks is welcome.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.

About the Role:

Product Engineer (Backend Focus) who combines strong backend expertise with a product-oriented mindset and a modern, AI-first approach to software development. This is not a traditional backend-only role. We need someone who can think beyond tickets and requirements — someone who can translate high-level business objectives into technical solutions and working prototypes.

In this role, you will design and implement backend systems primarily using JavaScript/TypeScript and Node.js, while leveraging AI tools such as Copilot, Cursor, LLM-based assistants, and other generative systems to accelerate development responsibly. The goal is not simply to generate more code — it’s to build faster without compromising architecture, testing discipline, QA processes, or release stability.

You will operate autonomously, take ownership of architectural decisions when needed, and help evolve how engineering teams work in an AI-accelerated environment. This role is ideal for someone who balances speed, quality, and maintainability while continuously improving delivery processes.

  • Leverage AI to understand legacy systems, refactor code, and accelerate development
  • Critically evaluate AI-generated outputs to ensure correctness and maintainability
  • Balance automation with engineering judgment

Evolving SDLC & QA:

  • Improve QA processes to support higher development velocity
  • Strengthen testing practices and CI/CD workflows
  • Help prevent technical debt while increasing output
  • Ensure release processes remain stable and scalable

Must-Have:

  • Strong backend engineering experience (Node.js / TypeScript environment)
  • Experience operating autonomously as a Product Engineer or senior backend contributor
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience using AI tools in real development workflows
  • Strong architectural thinking and system design skills
  • Deep understanding of testing, QA, and release processes
  • Ability to translate business objectives into technical execution

Nice to Have:

  • Experience improving CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience scaling QA processes in high-velocity teams
  • Exposure to DevOps practices
  • Experience working in AI-accelerated development environments

The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring Python and Kubernetes Specialist Engineers focused on Data, AI/ML and Analytics Solutions to join our teams building open source solutions for public cloud and private infrastructure.
As a software engineer on the team, you'll collaborate on an end-to-end data analytics and mlops solution composed of popular, open-source, machine learning tools, such as Kubeflow, MLFlow, DVC, and Feast. You may also work on workflow, ETL, data governance and visualization tools like Apache SuperSet, dbt, and Temporal, or data warehouse solutions such as Apache Trino, or ClickHouse. Your team will own a solution from the analytics and machine learning space, and integrate with the solutions from other teams to build the world's best end-to-end data platform. These solutions may be run on servers or on the cloud, on machines or on Kubernetes, on developer desktops, or as web services.
We serve the needs of individuals and community members as much as the needs of our Global 2000 and Fortune 500 customers; we make our primary work available free of charge and our Pro subscriptions are also available to individuals for personal use at no cost. Our goal is to enable more people to enjoy the benefits of open source, regardless of their circumstances.
Location: This initiative spans many teams that are home-based and in multiple time zones. We believe in distributed collaboration but we also try to ensure that colleagues have company during their work hourse! Successful candidates will join a team where most members and your manager are broadly in the same time zone so that you have the benefits of constant collaboration and discussion.
What your day will look like

  • Develop your understanding of the entire Linux stack, from kernel, networking, and storage, to the application layer
  • Design, build and maintain solutions that will be deployed on public and private clouds and local workstations
  • Master distributed systems concepts such as observability, identity, tracing

  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)

  • Appreciative of diversity, polite and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organisation
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
Additional Skills That Would Be Nice To Have

The following skills may be helpful to you in the role, but we don't expect everyone to bring all of them.
  • Hands-on experience with machine learning libraries, or tools.
  • Proven track record of building highly automated machine learning solutions for the cloud.
  • Experience with container technologies (Docker, LXD, Kubernetes, etc.)
  • Experience with public clouds (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
  • Working knowledge of cloud computing
  • Passionate about software quality and testing
  • Experience working on an open source project
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. We are looking for developers ready to tackle one (or more) of those challenges:

  • Ingestion: Handling massive streams of sensor data with minimal latency.
  • Intelligence: Making LLMs deterministic and reliable within robust multi-agent systems.

  • Rapid Delivery: Adopt a 'deliver fast' mentality without compromising on code quality, testing, or API design standards.

Possible paths to work on the Project (you can contribute to one or more):

Streaming & High-Throughput Data

  • Build Streaming Pipelines: Design scalable services using Kafka and Spark/Flink to process raw sensor data in real-time.
  • Time-Series Optimization: Optimize database schemas (TimescaleDB) to enable fast historical data retrieval and implement algorithmic checks to validate sensor readings.

GenAI & Autonomous Agents

  • Build Autonomous Agents: Deploy stateful agents (using LangGraph) that plan tasks, query Knowledge Graphs, and execute tools without hallucinating.
  • Advanced RAG: Build Graph-RAG pipelines that combine semantic search with structured knowledge traversal for grounded answers

Graph & Knowledge Engineering

  • Search Infrastructure: Implement Hybrid Retrieval logic combining Vector Search, Full-Text Search, and Graph traversal.

Qualifications

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
  • 5+ years of experience in Python Backend development.
  • Advanced English communication skills.
  • Computer Science fundamentals: Data Structures and Algorithms.
  • Strong experience building and documenting REST APIs (FastAPI).

Good to Have:

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

We use a modern, high-performance stack. You should be proficient in the Core and deeply knowledgeable in your chosen track.

  • Core Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI, Pydantic), Polars, Docker, Kubernetes.
  • Streaming: Apache Kafka, Flink, Spark Streaming, TimescaleDB, Tiger Data.
  • GenAI: LangGraph, LangChain, LiteLLM, Azure OpenAI/Anthropic/Local SLMs.
  • Graph/Data: Neo4j (Cypher), PostgreSQL (pg_vector, Full-Text Search).

At Zyte, we eat data for breakfast and you can eat your breakfast anywhere and work for Zyte. Your mission is to turn content, of all types, into fuel for growth—promoting and repurposing Zyte.com content, distributing it across our ICP communities and marketing channels, and ensuring Zyte stays top-of-mind for developers, data teams and data buyers.

Quantitative

Qualitative

Who You Are

  • Technical ICP-Focused: You know what resonates with developers and data professionals—and what falls flat.

How We Work

We move fast, learn loud, and optimize often. Campaigns are built around business goals—not bloated processes. You’ll have the autonomy to test, iterate, and scale ideas that work.

Work with cutting-edge open source technologies and tools.

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Uniforms Senior Manager is responsible for the planning and operational delivery of the corporate FIFA27 Business Casual uniform as well as the FWWC2027 Tournament Dedicated and FIFA Formal uniform programmes in line with the overall FIFA Uniform Strategy and the approved usage and entitlement matrix.

Key Responsibilities

  • Responsible for full project management and implementation of the FWWC2027 uniform programme including issuance operations that support both workforce and volunteers
  • Ensure all FIFA27 workforce have uniform according to the entitlement and usage matrix
  • Effectively collaborate with key FIFA Zurich and FIFA27 stakeholders including Workforce Planning, Volunteer Management, Host City Management, Logistics, Accreditation and Partnership Rights Delivery
  • Create strategy, process and flows for the full project plan for FWWC2027 uniform programme capturing risks and mitigations throughout
  • Develop the operational plan, setting up affiliated systems, identify functional distribution spaces, engage with stakeholders, contract local suppliers to deliver the FWWC2027 uniform programme, across all the Uniforms Distribution Centers
  • Oversee FIFA27 uniform budget, including creating accurate forecasts for each FIFA27 related event e.g. FWWC2027 Draw
  • Manage relationships with external uniform suppliers that may be required, ensuring compliance in line with Framework Agreement and enforcing contractual obligations
  • Recruit and effectively train and manage the uniforms team (both workforce and volunteers) during planning and delivery periods ensuring best practices are clearly defined and the service level provided across all Uniform Distribution Centers is consistent
  • Manage stock levels and keep up-to-date records of each uniform item during pre-tournament (e.g. Business Casual uniform/ formal items that may be required for side events) and tournament time.
  • Communicate the agreed FIFA27 Uniform Guidelines and Usage Policy at each FIFA tournament and event
  • Ensure the uniform guidelines are upheld and enforced across all client groups including FIFA Formal Uniform eligibility
  • Plan uniform distribution to all related FWW2027 additional events, e.g. Final Draw
  • Work with relevant FIFA27 stakeholders to agree and provide guidelines to Suppliers who are not entitled to Tournament Dedicated Uniforms
  • Other duties as necessary to ensure the smooth running of the FWWC2027 Uniform operations.

Your Profile

Qualifications and Experience

  • Minimum experience of 3 years in Uniform Management; preferably with experience in mega (sports) events and corporate organisations

  • Knowledge of event planning and event project management processes

  • Team Player, willing to work to tight timelines

  • Excellent time management skills and ability to balance competing priorities
  • Demonstrate initiative and a strong focus on providing a high level of service

Requirements

  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Senior R&D Manager
description:
Overview

InPlanet is a mission-driven, remote-first ClimateTech startup headquartered between Germany and Brazil with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York and London. We’re scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture as a powerful method to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform the way food is grown in the tropics. Our vision is simple but bold: to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating tropical soils in order to create a livable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We’re doing this in partnership with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders - and we’re growing fast. Our company culture blends people-first care and performance excellence . The Rocket represents our ambition and drive; the Heart symbolizes our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact. We’re proud of our globally diverse team and inclusive culture. Our teams span across continents, but our boots are firmly on the ground in Brazil - where the real climate impact happens. You can check out independent reviews by other candidates on Glassdoor to check how people find interviewing with us. Check out our Culture page here

About the Role

Ideal role for an experienced & ambitious scientist within agronomy. As our Senior Research and Development (R&D) Manager you will lead and be responsible for managing our research and development programme relating to deployment of Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) as a carbon dioxide removal technique in Brazil, with a special focus on agronomic trials. You will design, manage and interpret data from experiments in order to effectively monitor agronomic parameters and as well as helping to address fundamental research questions relating to ERW. You will be based in Brazil, with presence onsite at various locations within Brazil when necessary.

The Impact you can make

This role will oversee and manage team members, and you will take ownership over experiments, driving forward our scientific strategy. You lead our reporting on farmer co-benefits and impact metrics, providing robust scientific evidence to support the case for our wider impact. You will play a key role in managing and driving our science strategy and will be expected to maintain and develop relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

Core working relationships

Reporting to the VP of Science and Research, you will support and work effectively with all members of the science and operations teams. You will lead and work closely with our Science and Impact Lead and our Agronomic R&D Lead.

Key Responsibilities

  • Management of team members within our agronomy R+D programme
  • Overseeing and planning our agronomy R+D programme, such as the design of experiments and communication with external stakeholders
  • Generating, analysing, presenting, and publishing data from experiments and deployments to wide-ranging and high-profile audiences
  • You will support operations to provide the robust scientific evidence for our farmer pitches and case studies
  • You drive research and the wider science team strategy
  • You manage communications and partnerships with leading researchers globally, with a specific focus on Brazil
  • You will work with flexibility in Brazil, with travel to onsite experiments within Brazil and to visit partners (expectation & benefit)

You can be a Rock-Star if you have

Core Skills & Experience

  • You are an experienced senior scientist with a PhD (or equivalent experience) in Plant Science, Soil Science, Agronomy, Earth Science, Geochemistry, Biogeochemistry or related fields
  • You have, ideally, 5+ years of experience in senior research or research related roles
  • You have extensive experience in research and development and experimental design, with a focus on agronomy or a related field
  • You have a proven track record of previously successful research projects and publications in high quality journals
  • You have worked on successful research projects with a wide range of stakeholders and partners, e.g., from industry, government and academia.
  • You have knowledge of agronomy and agronomic trials
  • You are fluent in Portuguese
  • You have advanced English language skills
  • You are based in Brazil (ideally Piracicaba or Sao Paulo region)

title: Planning and Integration Manager
description:
Planning and Integration Manager

Department: Administration

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

This role focuses on coordinating operational planning, integration, risk and issue management, to ensure successful delivery of the tournament, hosted in Brazil.

The Project Manager will work with internal and external stakeholders, including FIFA and FIFA27, host cities, government entities, and venue authorities, to achieve excellence in planning, readiness, and execution.

This position offers a unique opportunity to shape the success of one of the most prestigious global sporting events and leave a lasting legacy for women’s football in Brazil and beyond.

The Project Manager will be a key role during tournament time, co-ordinating day-to-day operations at the Tournament Operations Centre and coordinating with stakeholders to resolve issues.

Travel and flexibility to work irregular hours may be required due to the nature of the event.

Project Management and Integration

  • Under the direction of FIFA’s Lead of FWWC Portfolio Management based in Zurich, implement the FIFA Project Management framework throughout the planning, readiness, implementation and closure phases of the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 project.
  • Assist to implement project management processes and standards within FIFA27.
  • Coordinate cross-functional and venue teams to ensure the integration of operational, venue and client planning activities.
  • Collaborate with Functional Areas (FAs) in FIFA27, Host Cities, and stakeholders to develop and implement comprehensive function and venue operating plans (Project Definitions, Operations Plans and Site Operational Plans).
  • Assist in the development of tournament-wide contingency plans and ensure functional area and venue alignment.
  • Assist in the development and maintenance of the master project plan, critical roadmap from a FIFA27 perspective, capturing all key milestones and tasks and the monitoring thereof.
  • Provide strategic and operational support, including tracking progress, risk-issue monitoring, and milestone adherence.

Reporting

  • Assist in the delivery of the Tournament Operations Centre (TOC) structures and systems to facilitate coordination and issue resolution.
  • Provide regular updates and reporting to senior leadership and stakeholders on progress, risks and issues. Help to compile presentations to senior management
  • Compile standardised reports on project progress, risks, and dependencies to ensure alignment with governance structures
  • Data extraction, consolidation and visualisations

Operational and Client Planning

  • Coordinate the development of client and functional operating plans, policies, and procedures using FIFA templates.
  • Assist in the definition and integration of client journey plans in collaboration with key stakeholders.
  • Manage the agreement process for client service levels and priorities.
  • Ensure consistency in planning and delivery across competition and non-competition venues.
  • Support Functional Areas in FIFA27 in preparing and maintaining activity and event schedules, monitoring risks, issues, and resource requirements.

Risk Management

  • Enable risk management processes, including identification, mitigation, and escalation of risks and issues across FIFA27.
  • Ensure compliance with ISO 31000 standards for risk management.
  • Support the development of strategic contingency plans.
  • Work with Functional Areas in FIFA27 to ensure risks are identified, documented and mitigated effectively.

Operational Readiness

  • Plan and conduct readiness exercises, including simulations, rehearsals, and testing of infrastructure, systems, and processes.
  • Build the capability of functional area and venue teams through tailored readiness activities.
  • Capture and implement lessons learned from readiness activities to optimize tournament delivery.
  • Prepare for tournament time by transitioning into the day-to-day coordination and issue management role within the Main Operations Centre.

Knowledge Management

  • Contribute to FIFA’s knowledge management initiatives, including the Observer Program, debriefs, lessons capture, and post-tournament reporting.
  • Ensure proper transfer of knowledge through documentation, photo capture, and archiving of key materials for future events.

Training and Development

  • Provide training to FIFA27 users on FIFA’s project management methodology and tools.
  • Ensure consistent application of project management principles across the organization.

YOUR PROFILE

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Business, Project Management, or a related field.
  • Knowledge of event planning and project management processes.
  • Familiarity with various project management methodologies, including Agile and Scrum, is an advantage.

Experience

  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in leading complex, large-scale projects, preferably in international mega-events or sports events.
  • Proven track record in developing and executing strategic and operational plans.
  • Experience managing stakeholder relationships across government, corporate, and community groups.
  • Expertise in project and risk management, issue management, operational readiness, and contingency planning.
  • Experience in tournament time operations, including incident management and resolution.
  • Experience working in cross-functional, multi-stakeholder and multi-cultural environments.

Certifications

  • Professional certifications such as PMP, APM, or Prince2 is required.

Skills & Competencies

  • Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
  • Experience with project management tools is an asset.
  • A good proficiency in visualisation tools such as Power BI or Tableau for reporting.
  • Familiarity with collaboration tools and systems for managing complex projects.

Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Design the future of decision‑making in energy.

  • Ability to translate research into product and business impact
  • Experience collaborating with cross‑functional product teams

For Both Roles

  • Experience navigating complex technical environments
  • Strong communication and stakeholder influence skills
  • Comfort working in legacy systems undergoing modernization
  • A desire to shape and elevate UX within a global enterprise organization

description:
Overview

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (FWWC 2027) that for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

The Senior Service Delivery Manager is responsible for all aspects of Service Delivery Management for Corporate and Tournament technology support operations for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (FWWC 2027) within Brazil. The role entails working in close collaboration with the Technology teams in Brazil and Zurich, and other key stakeholders.

Key responsibilities

  • Establish and implement a fit for purpose integrated support model (including FIFA, technology partners, service providers, government entities etc.) across all phases of the project.
  • Management / implementation of IT Service management processes and procedures including the management of the ITSM tool.
  • Establish service level agreements (SLAs) in accordance with the FIFA Technology Handbook across all technology services.
  • Be the lead manager for Service Delivery area within the FWWC27 Technology Project team
  • Recruitment of direct reports in the next phase of hiring & contracting, who will in turn be responsible to deliver their key area of scope.
  • Lead on the definition of the Asset tracking and management of deployed equipment in all sites.
  • Ensure all tasks and deliverables are completed to scope, within budget and on schedule.
  • Continuously review and make recommendations to improve technology across the tournament.
  • Contribute to the Technology readiness program, including test events and exercises, policies and procedures and training of the team
  • Be a key member of the Technology team and work collaboratively with colleagues across the organisation and FIFA Technology team as defined by the operational organizational structure.
  • Lead, build and manage a strong diverse team composed of paid staff, contractors, and volunteers for operating the technology services in scope.

Your profile

  • University degree or similar higher education, in Information Technology, Computer Science or related field
  • A minimum of 8 years overall IT experience and minimum 4 years of experience in a similar role
  • Experience in the Sports / major event industry
  • Proven track record of successful delivery of complex IT programs and project
  • Strong IT skills and relevant knowledge in Service Delivery Management.
  • Good Procurement and contract management skills
  • Highly adept at consulting, negotiating, communicating, consensus building and facilitation
  • Good analytical skills and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent people management, verbal and written communication, training, and presentation skills
  • Team Player, willing to work with tight timelines
  • Positive attitude, patience and persistence
  • ITIL foundations
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Proficiency in any other FIFA language (FR / ES / GER) is an asset
  • Willing to travel within Brazil (up to 20%)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

title: Senior Project Manager Travel
description:
Senior Project Manager Travel

Department: Events & Entertainment

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Senior Travel Project Manager oversees strategic travel planning, commercial management, and operations within the complex environment of a multi-stakeholder tournament.

This position plays a key role in ensuring the success of the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027 by organizing and managing travel projects that provide safe, efficient, and dependable transportation for everyone involved in the event.

Responsible for turning FWWC27 event requirements into practical travel plans, the Senior Travel Project Manager works under tight deadlines and in collaboration with various stakeholders.

Collaboration, accountability, and operational excellence are central to this role, which involves close coordination with the FIFA Global Travel team, other functional departments, host country authorities, and selected travel service providers.

The Senior Travel Project Manager ensures all projects adhere to company policies, service standards, sustainability commitments, and risk management practices. They also anticipate dependencies, address operational risks, and drive progress on key milestones.

By using structured project management methods and competency standards, this role supports consistent outcomes, builds stakeholder trust, and delivers an exceptional tournament experience. Additionally, it contributes to knowledge sharing, ongoing improvement, and planning for future events.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategic, Commercial & Financial Oversight

  • Ownership of tournament travel budget planning, cost benchmarking, and financial risk mitigation
  • Market benchmarking of airline/charter pricing to ensure competitiveness (RFP)
  • Identification, analysis, and escalation of pricing inconsistencies, capacity constraints, and commercial misalignments with airline and travel partners
  • Contribution to the development of travel rate cards, pricing frameworks, and commercial guidelines

Scenario Planning & Risk Management

  • Development of contingency plans for high level client groups
  • Proactive identification and mitigation of operational risk
  • Decision-making under high time pressure to ensure continuity of tournament operations while maintaining service levels and cost control

Senior Stakeholder & Executive Interface

  • Acting as an advisory interface between FIFA Functional Areas, External Stakeholders, Suppliers, Host Country Authorities, and FIFA/FWWC27 Senior leadership
  • Preparation of executive-level briefings, recommendations, and decision papers related to travel strategy, pricing, and operational readiness
  • Support to FIFA Partnerships in managing expectations with commercial partners in high-demand or capacity-constrained environments

Data, Systems & Process Governance

  • Oversight of travel-related data accuracy, reporting structures, and decision-support tools used throughout the tournament lifecycle
  • Ensuring transparency, traceability, and auditability of travel decisions, supplier selections, and cost structures
  • Contribution to the continuous improvement of FIFA travel handbooks, templates, operational playbooks, and systems

Tournament Scale & Complexity Management

  • End-to-end coordination of high-volume, multi-city charter and scheduled flight operations during tournament time
  • Ensuring consistent service delivery across multiple client groups (Teams, Delegates, Guests, VIPs, Workforce, FIFA/FWWC27 stakeholders)

YOUR PROFILE

Education

  • Completed (business) travel agency education or business education with training in the travel industry
  • Further education in tourism, event or general management

Experience

  • At least 5 years of experience in the business travel industry (travel, accommodation and ground transportation)
  • Excellent skills in GDS, preferably GDS Amadeus/ticketing and fare rules are a must
  • At least 2 years of experience in project and event management

Skills & Competencies

  • Experience in budgeting and accounting
  • Good negotiation skills
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese, additional languages beneficial
  • Practical commercial experience, distinguished geographical knowledge
  • Systemic and analytical thinking
  • Autonomy and sense of responsibility
  • Practical and process-oriented working profile with quality and efficiency
  • Intercultural competencies, Flexibility, adapting working processes to different cultures
  • Strong team player
  • Clear communication skills in different languages

  • Capability to promote knowledge transfer with other team members
  • Service-oriented working style
  • Taking initiative and working proactively

  • Vision to predict potential problematical scenarios and anticipate solutions
  • Creativity to solve unforeseen issues
  • Solution-oriented operation

title: Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager
description:
Overview

Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027"). For the first time, it is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department: Technical & Infrastructure

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager reports to the Dressing and Signage Senior Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team in close collaboration with the Venue Management team and other stakeholders. The FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ requires an outstanding look and feel project to be delivered in a seamless tournament experience. The Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager is responsible for leading the venue branding, look and signage operations and delivery strategy from planning through implementation to closure across all FIFA Official Sites. This position is responsible for overseeing the delivery of a world class dressing and signage project for all target groups attending matches of the FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™, ensuring that the look and feel is up to FIFA quality standards.

The role assumes event operational proficiency, venue dressing, signage and wayfinding knowledge with project management skills to directly oversee the dressing implementation at four FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ stadia. They will ensure that key project deliverables and deadlines are met within their sites and will be required to input into strategic project decisions taken by senior members of the team. They will oversee contracted provider operations within their sites, ensuring that all are managed successfully and efficiently while monitoring budgetary spending within agreed limits. They will ensure that precedents and strategic directives from the Head of Dressing and Signage and Senior Dressing and Signage Manager are followed as required by the members of the team. The role will collaborate closely with other dressing, signage, wayfinding and non-competition managers to maximize creativity and ensure consistency across all stadiums.

Key Responsibilities

  • Overseeing the turnkey planning of dressing and signage implementation across all official sites during planning phase, and stadium dressing for 3-5 stadia closer to the tournament.
  • Collaborating with the other Stadium Dressing Managers and ensuring that precedents are followed to guarantee consistency across all tournament stadiums.
  • Working closely with the Non-Competition Dressing Managers and the Wayfinding and Signage Managers as well as other Functional Area Managers, to maximize efficiencies across the wider project.
  • Being the focal point for all general stadium dressing questions or requests from the Head of Department.
  • Oversight of contracted provider planning, production and implementation for all stadiums within the assigned sites.
  • Constant monitoring of the budgetary impact of dressing operations and reporting updates to the Senior Manager and Head of Department regularly.
  • Providing strategic input into the stadium dressing planning process and offering expertise when required.
  • Adhering to project deadlines and deliverables as instructed by senior members of the department.
  • Daily liaison with other members of the wider Dressing and Signage team to ensure efficient planning and delivery is optimized at all stages of the project.
  • Liaising with stadium owners and operators as required to gain approval on implementation plans.
  • Presenting to senior team members, management and other FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ functional areas as and when required.
  • Attending department-specific and organization site visits at assigned stadiums and other stadiums or official sites.
  • Inputting into the site-specific dressing strategies utilizing expertise from previous events and directives from management.
  • Acting as the main stadium dressing point of contact for Dressing and Signage Venue Managers and other Functional Area Venue Managers within the assigned sites during the implementation phase of the project.
  • Participating in the creative design process for stadiums within the assigned sites.
  • Assisting with the recruitment of Dressing and Signage project team members in collaboration with the senior department leads if required.
  • Ensuring the needs of internal FIFA functional areas are captured and delivered against within the assigned sites.
  • Contribution to project management and knowledge management initiatives including event debriefs, and knowledge capture and documentation activities.
  • Ability to possibly be relocated to a Host City for up to three months in to act as a Dressing and Signage Venue Manager at an allocated stadium during the event periods.

Your Profile

  • Minimum 4+ years of experience in delivering dressing, signage, branding or look projects for events of a similar scale to FIFA World Cups, Olympic Games etc. or a minimum 2 years’ experience managing major sports events in a role that included the delivery of comprehensive dressing or signage related activities.
  • A working understanding of the technical aspects of delivering dressing and signage projects (i.e. production methods, installation techniques, materials etc.).
  • Strong understanding of stadium look and feel requirements and large-scale temporary installations.
  • Budget management experience on complex and multi-faceted events and projects.
  • Experience in managing providers of services for world-class events.
  • Knowledge of event planning, requirements and event project management processes for large sporting events.
  • Significant stakeholder management experience across multiple organizations and departments.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in appropriate subject (or adequate training/vocational education) Design, Architecture, Project Management, or a related field.
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools.
  • The role will require extensive use of the appointed Dressing and Signage Supplier(s) project, content and scoping management systems so a readiness to learn new technology processes, systems and programs is essential.
  • The role will require attending site visits and being away from home for periods of time, including on-site attendance during the tournament period.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Senior Manager, Retail & Licensing
description:
Senior Manager, Retail & Licensing

Department: Commercial & Marketing

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Senior Retail & Licensing Manager will be a key member of the FIFA27 Commercial Operations team, and work in close collaboration with the FIFA Zurich Head of Licensing & Retail and other key individuals responsible for delivering Licensing & Retail efforts for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027.

Key Responsibilities

  • Source, manage licensing domestic partners in coordination, collaboration and liaison with the FIFA Licensing & Retail (L&R) team in Zurich and aligned with the overall global L&R strategy to ensure the presence of a comprehensive, commercial and compelling range of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ licensed products in Brazil.
  • Develop and implement a national strategic licensing & retail plan in consultation and with approval of FIFA Licensing & Retail team in Zurich and aligned with the global Licensing Strategy. This will include planning product assortment, pricing, and distribution channels to maximize revenue and brand exposure in line with the overall Strategy for FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.
  • Ensure compliance with FIFA Licensing, Legal, Financial and Commercial Guidelines working with internal stakeholders.
  • Oversee the implementation and manage the approval of all brand executions (licensed products, packaging, pos, etc.).
  • Manage and oversee the production, quality control, and timely delivery of licensed products coordinating with suppliers, manufacturers, and distributors.
  • Analyse market trends, consumer behaviours, and competitor activities to identify new licensing and retail opportunities and optimize sales potential.
  • Manage relationships with retail partners, including brick-and-mortar stores, online platforms, and official FIFA Stores, ensuring brand consistency and driving sales growth.
  • Monitor and analyse sales performance, inventory levels, and consumer feedback to make data-driven decisions and implement corrective actions if needed.
  • Collaborate with FIFA Legal and Brand Protection to enforce licensing agreements, protect intellectual property rights, and prevent unauthorized use of FIFA trademarks.
  • Provide regular reports and presentations on Licensing & retail activities, including sales performance, market insights, and recommendations for improvement, to senior management and stakeholders.
  • Work with the relevant teams in the Brazil entity to stay informed on key milestones, activations, local and domestic implementations.
  • Oversee royalty reporting, ensure timely payment of remuneration and report back to L&R team in HOF.
  • Manage the contract management process via FIFA’s online system (BrandComply) and ensure the licensees adhere to this process.
  • Assist the L&R team in Zurich with the selection and appointment of retail concessionaires.

Your Profile

Education: Bachelor’s Degree or similar level of education in Marketing, Business Administration, Product Management.

Experience: Minimum of 7 years of work experience in licensing and/or event retail in Brazil with preference in the sports or entertainment industry. At least 3 years’ experience leading a team.

Skills & Competencies:

  • Solid communication, presentation, and negotiation skills
  • Thorough knowledge Brazilian market, retail, consumer products and sports and entertainment trends
  • Excellent understanding of product development, go-to-market processes, and retail distribution models
  • Positive and can-do attitude
  • Strategic thinker whilst tactical implementor
  • Highly organised and with a structured approach
  • Financial and legal understanding
  • Comfortable working in a cross-cultural and cross functional team
  • Stress resilient and used to working to tight deadlines.
  • Solid understanding of omni-channel retail
  • Understanding of complex stakeholder rights models

Requirements:

  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro.

If you can imagine yourself in this role, we look very much forward to hearing from you. Please apply through our website no later than 12 September 2025. We will review and interview on an ongoing basis, so please apply as soon as possible.

We are seeking a Cloud Engineer I to support a University Affiliated Research Center (UARC) acting as the central hub for a consortium of nine academic institutions. This role is critical in providing the secure, scalable, and high-performance Azure cloud infrastructure required to facilitate government‑contracted research and development (R&D) across the consortium.

The Azure Cloud Engineer will design and maintain a multi‑tenant environment that enables diverse research teams to collaborate seamlessly while adhering to stringent federal security requirements. The ideal candidate is a self‑starter capable of managing complex infrastructure that bridges the gap between traditional IT and advanced scientific research applications.

Duties And Responsibilities

  • Consortium Infrastructure Management: Design, configure, and manage Azure IaaS, SaaS, and PaaS solutions tailored to the unique R&D needs of the nine‑school consortium.
  • Secure Networking: Create and manage complex Azure networking services (firewalls, VNETs, subnets, VPNs, ExpressRoute) to ensure secure data transmission between consortium members and government sponsors.
  • Identity & Access Governance: Manage Azure Active Directory (Entra ID) to handle cross‑institutional authentication, ensuring researchers from all nine schools have appropriate, secure access to shared resources.
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Automate the rapid provisioning of research environments using ARM templates, Bicep, or Terraform to support fluctuating project demands.
  • Research Computing Support: Configure and manage high‑performance computing (HPC) clusters, containers (AKS), and serverless environments to handle large‑scale data analysis and simulations.
  • Data Stewardship: Manage and support diverse data storage solutions including Azure Files, Blob Storage, and Data Warehousing to facilitate long‑term research data retention and sharing.
  • Performance & Cost Optimization: Proactively monitor Azure resources to ensure peak performance for computationally intensive tasks while optimizing costs across multiple research grants and task orders.
  • Automation & Scripting: Develop PowerShell and BASH scripts to automate data manipulation, transformation, and routine administrative tasks.
  • UARC Compliance: Ensure all cloud deployments comply with FedRAMP, NIST 800‑171, and CMMC requirements essential for government‑contracted research.

Competencies / Qualifications

  • Azure Expertise: Direct experience in the Azure Cloud platform with a focus on architecting solutions for multi‑tenant or collaborative environments.
  • Automation Skills: Strong scripting experience using PowerShell and BASH for environment orchestration and configuration management.
  • Full‑Stack Cloud Knowledge: Advanced experience in IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS implementations, including monitoring and automated recovery.
  • DevOps Integration: Experience in Azure DevOps services, CI/CD pipelines, and Agile processes within a research or academic context.
  • Specialized Knowledge: Familiarity with High‑Performance Computing (HPC) in Azure and meeting FedRAMP/government security benchmarks.
  • Collaboration: Proven ability to work across institutional boundaries and communicate technical concepts to non‑technical research faculty and stakeholders.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 3 years of hands‑on experience implementing and supporting Azure IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS.
  • 3 years of experience with PowerShell, BASH, or Azure CLI.
  • 3 years of experience in Azure networking services within a large‑scale or multi‑site organization.
  • Demonstrated experience with Azure design and management within a complex, fast‑paced environment.
  • Excellent problem‑solving skills and the ability to work independently.

Education

  • BS degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent years of professional experience).

Desired Certifications

  • Azure Solutions Architect Expert
  • Azure Security Engineer Associate
  • Azure Identity and Access Administrator Associate
  • Certified ITIL Foundation 4

Engineering Manager - Feegow (100% remote friendly in Brazil)

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Welcome to the good side of tech . You might have heard about us but with a different name: Feegow, Doctoralia or Docplanner. The names are different depending on the country we are located in, but we are all part of Docplanner Group.

It all started over 12 years ago when we asked ourselves: is anyone in healthcare thinking about patients? We jumped in and we empowered patients by giving them access to leave and read reviews about their visit. We then provided doctors with the technology to manage bookings easily and save time, so they could devote themselves to what they always wanted: treating patients. And today is the day in which we ask you: wanna join us in the next step of making the healthcare experience more human?

Where does Feegow fit here?

In 2022 Feegow joined the Docplanner Group, a health‑tech company. We are dedicated to developing innovative solutions and promoting access to top‑tier management for physicians seeking to take their practices to the next level, as well as managers in search of a robust solution that covers end‑to‑end operations. Our ultimate goal is to create a world where everyone can access high‑quality healthcare.

Docplanner Group at scale

We are leaders in 13 countries so far, and more than 80 million patients trust us every month. 130,000 specialists believe in us and our product, and so do leading venture capital funds such as Point Nine Capital, Goldman Sachs Asset Management, and One Peak Partners. And yet, employing over 2,500 people all over the globe, we managed to keep the startup‑mindset we started with over 10 years ago.

And why should you join us?

Because it feels good to tell your family and your friends how you made the world a little bit better. You go to bed knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs.

We want to make the healthcare experience more human, and that starts with you being you. We believe that considering the diversity of human experience makes a better healthcare experience for all. We’re not just different: we embrace diversity. We will encourage you to come to work your whole self, and that includes not coming to the office at all if you prefer not to, as we’re 100% remote‑friendly (you will work 100% from home, but you will also be welcome in our offices in Curitiba and Rio de Janeiro).

Role

As an Engineering Manager in this group, you’ll be fully responsible and accountable for managing your team(s), ensuring predictable, high‑quality delivery with high operational standards. You’ll also actively partner with your Product counterparts and Staff Engineers to shape the direction of our area and the company as a whole. The role reports directly to the Engineering Director.

We are committed to continuous improvement, open feedback, and working efficiently towards our goals. This role provides an opportunity to influence the strategic direction of the area while receiving mentorship and support as needed.

While expertise in specific technologies isn’t required, this is a technical role, and a solid technical background is essential to effectively support the teams.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Lead and represent ~10 direct reports in total, organized in smaller multi‑disciplinary teams.
  • Provide accountability for all the initiatives of your teams.
  • Work closely with the technical leaders of the group and the area to develop an effective technical strategy.
  • Act as a point of reference for our Leadership team and for the main stakeholders of your teams.
  • Provide guidance, mentorship, and coaching inside the team, through regular feedback and performance assessments.

Qualifications

You’re likely a great fit for this role if you

  • Have a solid technical background related to the whole SDLC and can support and unblock your teams in complex technical discussions.
  • Have experience in modernizing legacy systems to modern architectures as well as leading teams’ ways of working.
  • Comfortable communicating in written and verbal English across global teams.
  • Approach software development with a lean, proactive, and positive mindset, balancing impact and long‑term sustainable development, with a strong accountability for delivering high‑quality solutions.
  • Embrace the “you build it, you run it” philosophy.
  • Believe in continuous learning and improvement.
  • Are driven to lead and nurture high‑performing and healthy teams.
  • Have experience not only mentoring others but also developing future mentors and leaders.
  • Previous experience in consulting is a plus.

Important: Docplanner is an international English‑first company. Therefore, please be sure to send your CV in English.

Additional Information

  • Working hours are from Monday to Friday, from 9 am to 6 pm;
  • We have compensatory time off (Banco de Horas);

  • Medical, Dental, and Group Life Insurance;

  • Creditas: Payroll loan services, eligible after 6 months of employment;

  • Partnership Club, with discounts ranging from teaching institutions, such as colleges and language learning services;
